rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 2AA/full blastocyst, describing compact ICM and cohesive TE appropriately, but it adds speculative image-specific details (e.g., eccentric ICM, no hatching defect, zona comments) that are not clearly verifiable from the provided information/image.

Integrates key factors well: maternal age 38 as the main limiter, PCOS context, good endometrium, strong oocyte maturity yield, favorable sperm parameters, BMI/lifestyle, and first-cycle status. AMH absence is noted appropriately.

Overall logic is sound, but the response contains internal inconsistency in probability framing across the draft and final text (35-50%, 40-55%, 45-60%) and some speculative discussion about fresh vs frozen transfer without clear case data.

Recommendations are broadly aligned with IVF practice: SET for a good-quality blastocyst, caution that morphology does not equal euploidy, luteal support, no bed rest, and individualized discussion of PGT-A. Minor overreach/speculation prevents a perfect score.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, monitoring, uterine reassessment if repeated failure, and discussion of PGT-A/freeze-all in selected scenarios. Useful though somewhat generalized.
